title: Ellaisamy
desc: A righteous village chieftain finds himself in a situation where a woman is assaulted. Will he resort to justice, or will he take matters into his own hands?

title: Enaintha Kaikal
desc: A grieving mother hires a former soldier to break her son, Gunasekaran, out of a secure military jail. Meanwhile, a ruthless criminal sends a fugitive to kidnap the youth and assassinate the veteran.

title: Isai Paadum Thendral
desc: Mohan's father wants him to marry Menaka, but Mohan likes Kalyani. His father soon gives in to his demands, but Menaka has other plans.

title: Perarsu
desc: CBI officer Kasi gets tasked to investigate the disappearance of a judge. However, when he finds the culprits, who are three corrupt policemen, they get killed one by one and Kasi gets framed for it.
